source_context.request: Build repeatable browser/tab information extraction machine and send to bridge/Pen. User will paste one browser/tab dump at a time; system must disseminate content into buckets and push to dev/Pen for build completion.

objective: Create an operational intake pipeline for browser/tab dumps that extracts reusable information, classifies work, preserves learning, routes build/fix work to dev, and records evidence without summarising away actionable content.

buckets.description: Code, broken workflows, half-finished systems, deployment gaps, bugs, missing triggers, missing receipts, failed integrations.
Reusable snippets, frameworks, widgets, novel concepts, business ideas, productised patterns, templates, prompts, research/IP assets.
Claims of done/live/deployed/pushed/working that require receipts, runtime evidence, GitHub commits, Supabase audit rows, logs, screenshots, or test output.
Duplicates, stale notes, weak ideas, conflicting material, obsolete build attempts, no-payoff fragments. Archive only; do not delete.

actions.type: inspect | fix | build | validate | register | archive

worker_requirements: Ingest pasted tab dumps as immutable raw records.
Generate one structured extraction row per tab using per_tab_template.
Dedupe against prior tab_ids, URLs, titles, code hashes and action slugs.
Route BUILD_FIX to dev queue only when actionable.
Route REUSE_IP to asset/IP registry with business mapping.
Route VALIDATE_EVIDENCE to evidence register until REAL proof exists.
Route ARCHIVE_NOISE to archive register; never delete.
Emit receipt with counts by bucket and action IDs created.
Mark PRETEND claims rejected, not complete.
Expose status in Command Centre if available.
acceptance_tests: Given one pasted browser tab, output exactly one extraction object and zero or more action objects.
Given duplicate tab content, worker must not create duplicate dev actions; it must link to existing action IDs.
Given a claim of deployment without a receipt, evidence_state must be PARTIAL or PRETEND_REJECTED, never REAL.
Given code in a tab, worker must preserve code block and route to BUILD_FIX or REUSE_IP with reuse notes.
Given no actionable content, worker must archive with reason and no dev enqueue.
closure_note: Browser/tab extraction machine packaged for Pen/bridge worker. Await downstream REAL runtime receipt before claiming build complete.
